title: System Design Basics
description: Learn the fundamentals of system design including scalability, load balancing, and architecture patterns.

sections.title: What is System Design?
sections.content: System design is the process of designing the architecture of a software system.

sections.title: Scalability
sections.content: Scalability means handling increased load by adding resources.

description: Follow clean code, modular architecture, and proper version control in modern development.

description: Improve speed and efficiency of web applications.

sections.content: Split your code into smaller bundles to improve load time.
